en.hubeali: Muhammad Bin Ismail, from Al Fazl Bin Shazaan, from Safwan Bin Yahya and Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Hammad Bin Isa, altogether from Muawiya Bin Ammar who said,
‘I heard Abu Abdullahasws saying: ‘When the water was of the measurement of a Kurr (Three and a half open palm’s width cubed), nothing would pollute it’.
en.sarwar: 1. Muhammad ibn ’Isma‘il has narrated from al-Fadl ibn Shadhan from Safwan ibn Yahya and Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from Hammad ibn ‘Isa all from Mu‘awiyah ibn ‘Ammar who has said the following: “I heard abu ’Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, say, ‘
If the quantity of water is one Kur, then things do not make it unclean.”’
